name: rich-city-league
description: Rich City League - Basketball League Management & Social Platform

scripts.test:rls: command -v supabase >/dev/null 2>&1 && supabase status >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'Local Supabase is unavailable. Start it with npm run db:start before running RLS tests.' >&2; exit 1; }; supabase test db --local
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:rls
scripts.lab:motion:author: node scripts/author-stationary-dribble.mjs
scripts.lab:motion:check-target: npm run lab:motion:author && npm run lab:motion:validate -- public/lab3d/motion/stationary-dribble-target-report.json
scripts.lab:motion:ready-stance: npm run lab:motion:rig-report && npm run lab:motion:validate-anatomy && node scripts/build-quaternius-ready-stance.mjs
scripts.lab:v4:target: npm run lab:motion:analyze-rig && npm run lab:motion:validate-anatomy && node scripts/build-quaternius-ready-stance-v4.mjs
scripts.lab:v4:build: npm run lab:v4:target && node scripts/reconstruct-quaternius-ready-stance.mjs && node scripts/bake-quaternius-ready-stance.mjs
scripts.lab:defensive-slide:author: node scripts/author-defensive-slide.mjs
scripts.lab:defensive-slide:validate: npm run lab:v4:build && npm run lab:defensive-slide:author
scripts.lab:closeout:author: node scripts/author-closeout.mjs
scripts.lab:closeout:bake: npm run lab:v4:build && npm run lab:closeout:author && node scripts/bake-closeout.mjs
scripts.lab:triple-threat-jab:author: node scripts/author-triple-threat-jab.mjs
scripts.lab:triple-threat-jab:bake: npm run lab:v4:build && npm run lab:triple-threat-jab:author && node scripts/bake-triple-threat-jab.mjs
scripts.lab:dribble-stance:author: node scripts/author-dribble-stance.mjs
